description: This file contains a Roslyn analyzer for C# code that checks for proper usage of serialization attributes in Orleans project source code. It defines a class 'GenerateSerializationAttributesAnalyzer' which inspects syntax nodes related to class, struct, record, and record struct declarations to enforce certain attribute configurations.

classes.name: GenerateSerializationAttributesAnalyzer
classes.description: A Roslyn diagnostic analyzer that enforces rules on serialization attributes in C# source code for Orleans.

methods.name: CheckSyntaxNode
methods.description: Analyzes syntax nodes representing class, struct, record, or record struct declarations to verify the presence and configuration of serialization attributes.

methods.name: GetGenerateFieldIdsValue
methods.description: Extracts the 'GenerateFieldIds' value from the attribute syntax, defaulting to 'None' if not specified.
